title: chelone lyonii f. latifolia
intro: Chelone lyonii f. latifolia, commonly known as the Broad-leaved Turtlehead or the Large Turtlehead, is a flowering plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Chelone lyonii f. latifolia are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
